description: Finds monotonicity violations among Hyperliquid HIP-4 'above $X' price-binary markets: within the same underlying/expiry/period, a higher strike's Yes price should never exceed a lower strike's - any reversal is a logical inconsistency, quantified as violation_bp and a textbook max_riskless_profit_per_usd (before fees/slippage/execution risk - not investment advice). Reuses prediction.hip4_price_ladder's cache - no new upstream call. Only rungs sharing the exact same (expiry, period) are ever compared. Paid in USDC on Base.

underlying.description: Asset symbol for crypto price-binary markets (e.g. 'BTC', 'ETH', 'SOL', 'HYPE').
